title: EmailFilterCondition::has_attachment is Option<bool> — flag as opinion, spec-mandated
description: Option<bool> in a public API is usually a design smell per idiomatic Rust (the three states should have named variants). However EmailFilterCondition::has_attachment directly represents RFC 8621 §4.4.1 wire type 'hasAttachment: Boolean|null'. The three states map exactly to: None (field absent = no constraint), Some(true) (must have attachment), Some(false) (must not have attachment). An enum HasAttachmentFilter { Any, Yes, No } would be cleaner but adds a conversion layer between the type and the wire bool. For a types-only crate that is a faithful wire representation, Option<bool> is the correct call. Mark as opinion.
